focus.product: Plastic-injection moulds and press (stamping) dies, incl. die components, for car, motorcycle and electronics parts
focus.why: Densest named mould/die base found: Meiwa Mold, Yamaha Motor Mold, Umeda, Rhythm (MM2100), MS Mold (GIIC), Wing (EJIP), Banshu (Jababeka), next to their buyers (about 21 plastics-related and 10 stamping/press tenants on MM2100's list; Suzuki, MMKI, Hyundai, Wuling, AHM, Epson). Indonesia imported US$214.0M of 848071 injection moulds (68% from China) and US$195.5M of all HS 8207 interchangeable tools in 2025 (820730 press tools not split out). Moulds and dies are CNC milling, EDM and grinding work.

also.product: Jigs, checking fixtures and gauges for tier-1 assembly and machining lines
also.why: Banshu (Jababeka), Mekamix (Tarumajaya) and Mytek (Delta Silicon, snippet) already sell jigs and checking fixtures. Low-volume, high-mix fixtures suit CNC plus 3D-printed plastic nests and gauges. HS codes are approximate; fixtures have no single code and import values were not retrieved.

also.product: Machined wear and spare parts for process plants and pumps (bushings, sprockets, crusher and kiln parts)
also.why: Kab./Kota Bekasi IKM already hold TKDN certificates for these: Kito Multi (sprockets, crusher, kiln parts, 41-48%), Epsindo (bushings, 73.75%), Fusoh (mining bushings), Lerindro (pump throat bushings). 2025 imports: 841391 pump parts US$300.0M, 847490 crusher parts US$288.1M, 848390 US$118.7M.

focus.product: Machined cast and forged powertrain parts (engine, transmission and motorcycle drivetrain components) as tier-2/3 and spare-part work for the Karawang powertrain plants
focus.why: The belt holds the powertrain end of the chain: Toyota, Yamaha, Isuzu, Aisin Takaoka (KIIC); Daihatsu Drivetrain (DDMI), Art Piston, NT Piston Ring, Musashi, JTEKT (Suryacipta); Honda Precision Parts, AHM, Koyama Casting and a molten-aluminium supplier (Indotaisei). KIIC is 59% automotive/motor; 71 of Suryacipta's 175 tenants are automotive and parts. Machining castings and forgings is CNC turning and milling work. 2025 import values for these codes were not retrieved.

also.product: Die-casting dies, foundry patterns and core boxes for local aluminium and iron foundries
also.why: Captive buyers sit in the belt (Koyama Casting, Dongil Casting, Aisin Takaoka, Molten Aluminum Producer Indonesia) and die makers already operate (Fuji Technica in KIIC, Toyo Dies in Suryacipta). 2025 imports: 848041 US$9.5M, 848049 US$14.4M, 848030 US$10.8M. Dies need CNC and EDM; patterns and sand cores suit 3D printing, but no local AM bureau was found.

also.product: Assembly jigs, fixtures and gauges for EV, battery and electric-motorcycle lines
also.why: HLI Green Power battery-cell plant in Karawang (opened Jul 2024, 10 to 20 GWh) plus BYD and VinFast in neighbouring Subang, which must move from 40% to 60% TKDN by Jan 2027. Suryacipta lists EV and e-motorcycle newcomers (Yadea, TVS, Huayu, Zhongke). Fixtures are low-volume and high-mix, which suits 3D printing plus CNC.
